UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user profile with Admin-only RBAC role assignment and approval status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

role.description: Assigned role governing app capabilities; PENDING until approved by an Admin.

approvalStatus.description: Admin approval workflow status for Google-created accounts.

rejectionReason.description: Optional reason provided when an Admin rejects an access request.

approvedByUid.description: Optional UID of the Admin who approved or rejected the account.

RoleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment
RoleAssignment.description: Admin-managed role assignment keyed by lowercased Google email.

email.description: Target user Google email (lowercased, matches document ID).

displayName.description: Assigned display name for the staff/user.

assignedByUid.description: UID of the Admin who created or updated this assignment.

SupportTicket.title: SupportTicket
SupportTicket.description: Technical support repair ticket with 4-stage lifecycle and before/after photo proof.

title.description: Short summary of the hardware or software issue.

creatorUid.description: UID of the user who submitted the ticket.

creatorName.description: Display name of the ticket creator.

assigneeUid.description: Optional UID of the assigned technician.

assigneeName.description: Optional display name of the assigned technician.

teamLeadUid.description: Optional UID of the Team Lead who assigned the ticket.

defectPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 string of the product defect photo.

resolvedPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 string of the post-repair verification photo.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status or field update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

completedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when ticket reached COMPLETED.

TicketNotification.title: TicketNotification
TicketNotification.description: Real-time notification event triggered on ticket assignment, status, or invoice changes.

recipientUid.description: UID of the user who should receive this notification.

senderUid.description: UID of the user whose action triggered this notification.

ticketId.description: Document ID of the related ticket.

ticketCode.description: Display code of the related ticket.

newStatus.description: Ticket status associated with this notification.

readFlag.description: Whether the recipient has read this notification.

ProductItem.title: ProductItem
ProductItem.description: Shared catalog item for replacement parts and repair services managed by Team Leads and Admins.

name.description: Display name of the replacement part or service.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. Cái, Bộ, Thanh).

note.description: Optional warranty or stock specification note.

active.description: Whether this item is currently selectable for new invoices.

createdByUid.description: UID of the Team Lead or Admin who created the item.

RepairInvoice.title: RepairInvoice
RepairInvoice.description: Repair billing invoice attached 1:1 to a support ticket with parts line items, labor fee, and payment tracking.

ticketId.description: Document ID of the associated support ticket (matches invoice document ID).

ticketCode.description: Human-readable code of the associated support ticket.

creatorUid.description: UID of the ticket creator for transparent cost viewing.

assigneeUid.description: Optional UID of the assigned technician.

items.description: Snapshot list of up to 50 replacement part or service line items.

partsSubtotal.description: Sum of line item totals in VND.

laborFee.description: Repair service labor fee in VND.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the staff member who created or last updated the invoice.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the staff member who last updated the invoice.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last invoice update.

paidAt.description: Optional server timestamp when marked as PAID.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Physical spare parts and supplies inventory record with on-hand stock, low-stock alert threshold, and invoice deduction tracking.

name.description: Display name of the spare part or supply item.

productId.description: Optional linked catalog document ID in /products.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. Cái, Bộ, Thanh).

location.description: Optional warehouse shelf or storage location.

active.description: Whether this inventory item is active for issuance.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the staff member who created or last updated the stock level.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last stock or field update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Authenticated user profiles with Admin-controlled RBAC roles.

/role_assignments/{emailId}.description: Admin-managed role invitations and assignments keyed by lowercased Google email.

/tickets/{ticketId}.description: Support tickets tracked across 4 sequential states with defect and resolution photos.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Real-time push notification records scoped to recipientUid.

/products/{productId}.description: Shared replacement parts and repair services catalog managed by Team Leads and Admins.

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: Repair invoices keyed by ticketId with itemized replacement parts, labor fees, and payment status.

/inventory/{inventoryId}.description: Spare parts inventory tracking stock quantities, low-stock thresholds, and automatic invoice deductions.
